text: Evenepoel seized the moment when it mattered most, storming clear on the final climb to edge out Pogačar in a two-man duel that reshuffled the entire race. Vingegaard's exit via a high-speed crash gutted his podium hopes and handed UAE an unexpected gift—but Pogačar's ice-cool response kept him in yellow despite Remco's breakthrough. Lipowitz and Seixas salvaged what they could further back, though Red Bull-Bora now faces an awkward internal calculus with one week remaining. The gap is razor-thin: five seconds separates the top two, and Evenepoel has served notice he's not a supporting player anymore.
